text:
If you're hoping to squeeze in some outdoor time today, get it done before lunch. NWS has a high near 87 with heat index near 91, but showers and thunderstorms move in after that late-morning window, and the models are all over the place on how wet it gets. The American model keeps it fairly tame near 43% coverage, but the European is soaked at 94% with locally heavy rain possible, and given that split I'd plan like the wetter side wins. The lake's tracking the same story, south winds 5 to 10 knots early becoming southeast, waves 1 to 2 feet, showers likely with a slight chance of thunderstorms and some producing heavy rain in the afternoon. Water's a swimmable 76 if you get out early. Tonight stays humid and unsettled, low around 72, with storms likely before 10pm.

Friday looks better, mostly sunny and a high near 88, though humid again with only a slim shower chance late. Bermuda high keeps this pattern parked through early next week, so enjoy any dry stretch you get. Best call: any waterfront or lake plans today happen before noon, not after.
